processes.name: Quote Management
processes.description: Processes customer requests for custom cargo and car trailers, capturing specifications like width, depth, front style, and finish options to generate accurate pricing.
pain_points: Complex custom configurations increase error risk

processes.name: Custom Manufacturing & Production Scheduling
processes.description: Converts approved quotes into build orders, manages raw material procurement, coordinates assembly line workflows, and conducts in-process quality inspections.
pain_points: Supply chain delays for specialized components

processes.name: Dealer Channel Management & Onboarding
processes.description: Handles dealer applications, integrates financing partnerships (e.g., Sheffield Financial), manages dealer portal access, and maintains the store locator system.

processes.name: Warranty Registration & Claims Processing
processes.description: Manages lifetime warranty registrations, validates claims against dealer/purchase records, and authorizes repairs or part replacements per company policy.
pain_points: Manual claim verification across decades of models
Tracking coverage eligibility for used trailers

processes.name: Customer Support & Parts Fulfillment
processes.description: Provides technical assistance, distributes owner’s manuals, and processes spare parts orders for existing trailer owners.
pain_points: Identifying correct parts for older/custom builds
High volume of technical support inquiries
Shipping costs and logistics for heavy components

processes.name: Quality Assurance & Customer Feedback Collection
processes.description: Collects and analyzes customer survey data, monitors warranty claim trends for defect identification, and drives continuous improvement initiatives.
pain_points: Linking feedback to specific production batches
Translating insights into actionable engineering changes

scored_opportunities.name: Custom Spec Extractor & Quote Validator
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Parses incoming customer emails and web forms for trailer dimensions, front styles, and finish options, auto-fills the quote template, and flags non-standard configurations for human review.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual specification verification slows turnaround and increases error risk for custom builds.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value due to direct impact on quote accuracy and turnaround time, low risk as it only prepares data for human approval.

scored_opportunities.name: Production Schedule Status Assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Answers dealer and customer inquiries about order status by pulling real-time data from the production scheduling system, assembly line workflows, and shipping records.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual status checks require production staff to interrupt workflow and search across multiple systems.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Low effort and risk with solid value by reducing repetitive status inquiries without touching safety-critical scheduling logic.

scored_opportunities.name: Dealer Compliance & Financing Doc Preparer
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Reviews submitted dealer applications and multi-lender financing paperwork, checks for missing signatures or branding compliance, and generates a standardized compliance checklist.
scored_opportunities.gap: Inconsistent dealer compliance and complex multi-lender paperwork require manual document review.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Moderate value and effort, risk is controlled by keeping the agent strictly in a preparatory role per safety guidelines.

scored_opportunities.name: Warranty Eligibility Verifier
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Cross-references submitted warranty claims against historical dealer/purchase records and model databases to validate coverage eligibility and flag potential fraud or expired warranties.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual claim verification across decades of models is time-consuming and prone to coverage disputes.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value due to fraud prevention and faster claim resolution, with moderate risk mitigated by human final approval.

scored_opportunities.name: Legacy Parts Identifier Assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Matches customer-provided trailer serial numbers and build years to historical parts catalogs, recommending exact replacement components for older or custom builds.
scored_opportunities.gap: Identifying correct parts for older/custom builds requires manual cross-referencing of outdated manuals and serial logs.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Solid value by reducing incorrect part shipments and support call duration, with low risk as it only suggests parts for human verification.

scored_opportunities.name: Warranty-Trend Feedback Analyzer
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Aggregates warranty claim data and customer survey responses, tags them by production batch and component type, and generates a monthly defect trend report for engineering.
scored_opportunities.gap: Low survey response rates and disconnected feedback make it hard to link issues to specific production batches.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value as a foundational data cleanup/knowledge base step that enables future agents, with minimal risk and moderate effort.

scored_opportunities.name: Website AI assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Greets visitors and offers starting choices (Request Quote; Contact Dealers; View Brochures), answers common questions from approved business information, and hands off to a person.
scored_opportunities.gap: No AI chatbot or chat widget was found on the pages read.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: ratings set by code (fixed defaults), not by the model

roadmaps.rationale: Starting with the lowest-risk initiatives aligns perfectly with an owner who prefers caution, as it minimizes operational disruption while building foundational data quality. Placing the foundation work first ensures engineering receives reliable defect trends before scaling to customer-facing scheduling and quoting tools. This sequence reduces the chance of compounding errors in a custom manufacturing environment where production accuracy directly impacts dealer trust and warranty costs.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Warranty-Trend Feedback Analyzer serves as the pilot because it requires minimal integration with live production systems, allowing the team to validate data aggregation and reporting processes without risking order fulfillment or quote accuracy.
roadmaps.assumption: This plan assumes that historical warranty claims and customer survey data are sufficiently digitized and accessible to be reliably aggregated without extensive manual cleanup.

roadmaps.rationale: Given the owner’s cautious risk profile, sequencing initiatives by lowest risk ensures that Car Mate Trailers avoids disruptive failures and maintains steady operations during digital transformation. The production status assistant and warranty trend analyzer rely on established data streams and carry minimal implementation friction, allowing the team to validate processes safely. This conservative progression builds internal competence before introducing slightly higher-risk quoting automation.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Production Schedule Status Assistant is piloted first because it operates entirely within existing workflows and carries the lowest implementation risk, aligning perfectly with the owner’s cautious approach.
roadmaps.assumption: The core manufacturing and shipping data systems are stable, accurate, and available for integration without requiring costly infrastructure upgrades.

rubric.objection: The 'Warranty Eligibility Verifier' is placed third, which may be too late to address the owner's risk tolerance.
